proposal:
VERDICT: no universal mechanism, no polynomial SAT algorithm, no state bound. Everything is hand-derived, unexecuted and not machine-checked. MDP below is an EXPERIMENT outside blq-root-scc-emra-ialh5-v2.

AUDIT OF v2 (inferred from the description, untested).
(a) Coverage law. An odd block has trivial stabilizer, so its annihilator is all of F_2^S. If the greedy is compatible, the accepted rank is r = n - dim K, with K = {d : d|S stabilizes Z_S for every block S}. Extras therefore cost by which variables they cover, not by their number; all_variables_in_odd_blocks is the case K = 0. The fixture tests this. It is auto00010 minus its last clause, so it has one odd block. K has dimension 4 (pair flips inside {7,8,9} and {10,11,12}). Predicted: accepted quotient with 8 variables and 22 clauses (17 six-wide, 5 binary), root UNSAT.
(b) Classifying peak 16. auto00010 is G(parity of four triples) plus two extras, where G is a 4-variable UNSAT 2-CNF. Under the interleaved order all four triples straddle the cut for layers 4-8. Residuals for different partial parities are sign-translates, never literally equal, giving 2^4. That is a compression failure, not a hard trace. Proposed diagnostic: straddle rank sigma_pi(i) = number of gadgets split by the cut with both partial classes live; conjecture peak >= 2^sigma on skip.
(c) v2's stronger-disjunct pruning already absorbs extras dynamically (by my hand count layer 5 of auto00010 would otherwise exceed 16), but only once the order completes a gadget.

MECHANISM: module dominance pins (MDP), root only, before Canon.
For a variable set M, Res(a) is the set of literal residual clauses of the clauses meeting M under x_M = a. Point a dominates a' if Res(a) is a subset of Res(a'). A pin is a subcube (T,c), T inside M, such that every a' is dominated by some a with a_T = c. Emit units x_T = c.
Retraction lemma (hand proof): F is SAT iff F plus the units is SAT. If (a',y) is a model, y satisfies Res(a'), which contains Res(a), so (a,y) is a model; the converse is trivial. There is no lift map, no basis and no 2^n check. The certificate is a dominator table checked in O(2^|M| L_M) lookups. Inclusion survives restriction, so pins on disjoint M compose.
Candidates M: support-twin atoms (variables with identical block membership), with 2^|M| <= L. This is polynomial; it is not a completeness claim.
Scope: any gadget g that is non-constant on some extra-free line of its atom, linear or not; extras are handled by inclusion; dependent forms need no basis. TRC Theorem B is the special case where a is a K-translate.

Independent test 1 (hand): on auto00010 the atoms are the four triples, and x1=x2=x4=x5=x7=x8=x10=x11=1 is a valid pin set (each line {110,111} avoids the extra points 000 or 001). Appending these 8 units to auto00010 and running v2 unchanged should give compression skipped, root UNSAT, peak 0 against 16. The four dominator tables must be checked separately; the unit run alone says nothing about soundness.
Independent test 2: run MDP on auto00008 and auto00009. If atoms yield no pin, MDP does not explain those traces. I have not seen those formulas and predict nothing.
missing_theorem:
M0: the retraction lemma and its compatibility with restriction are hand proofs. Lean target: one general lemma plus a table checker, replacing per-instance 2^n enumeration.

FIRST UNSUPPORTED THEOREM, U16 (pinned-trace equivariance): for F = G(g_1..g_r) union E on disjoint atoms, each with a one-dimensional dominating line, v2 on F plus pins under any order pi produces the trace of v2 on G under the induced order, up to literal signs. This needs every stage (Canon, signed SCC, IALH tables, ELIM occurrence-product with variable-ID ties, stronger-disjunct pruning) to be invariant under sign flips and order-preserving renaming. ID and bitmask tie-breaks may break it. Unproved.

U17 (discovery beyond atoms): find a pin for unrestricted M in polynomial time. I expect NP-hardness, by analogy with set-blocked and propagation-redundant clause detection. No proof either way.

U18: the sigma lower bound for the real pruned trace. Unproved; node-level inference may undercut it.

None of these bounds peak(G). A universal bound is absent and I expect it to be false.
self_attack:
1. Known mathematics. A pin is a unit propagation-redundant or set-blocked clause with a table witness; modules are Ashenhurst-Curtis decomposition. The new content is only the root placement, the 2^|M| certificate, and the reading of v2's own pruning.
2. Reproducible adversary A_vc: on each triple attach a distinct extra clause to each of the four even points (16 extras on the 12-variable lift, partners chosen so no block keeps a stabilizer). The even points become pairwise incomparable and affinely span the cube, so no proper subcube dominates: MDP yields no pin, and with K = 0 v2 and TRC skip too. I do not know the peak. I conjecture >= 16 under the interleaved order. If v2 peaks low there, sigma is the wrong invariant.
3. Locality. A kernel vector of large support (chain x1+x2, x2+x3, ...) has no small module; only TRC's linear algebra sees it. Overlapping nonlinear scopes defeat both.
4. Encoding fragility. Auxiliary-variable splitting makes residual sets syntactically incomparable, and semantic dominance is coNP-hard.
5. The bound 2^|M| <= L is still a cap; wider gadgets are skipped.
6. Fixture risk. The prediction assumes the greedy ranks higher block membership first and enumerates the full annihilator of an odd block. If v2 skips instead, the original order runs and I expect peak 16. That outcome refutes audit (a) as a description of v2, not MDP.
7. Work accounting. Root MDP costs O(sum over atoms of 2^|M| L_M) plus hashing. Search after pins is unbounded.
8. Audit (b) and (c) are hand counts on a trace I cannot see.
mechanism_signature: MDP: module dominance pins. Root-only emission of units x_T=c for a subcube that dominates every point of {0,1}^M under literal-residual inclusion. Certificate: dominator table with an O(2^|M| L_M) check; no 2^n enumeration, no lift map, no basis. Preserves satisfiability only, not the model set. Candidates: support-twin atoms with 2^|M| <= L. Handles nonlinear gadgets and extras; misses wide kernel vectors, overlapping scopes and auxiliary encodings. Diagnostic: straddle rank sigma. No search bound.
delta_from_prior:
TRC was linear and global: translation kernel, pivots, and extras handled only through the pivot projection. New this round:
(1) MDP replaces translation by residual inclusion, so one-point-perturbed and other nonlinear gadgets with K = 0 come into scope. This partly answers last round's self-attack 2, for aligned atoms only.
(2) No lift map: accepted pins are units, so soundness needs one lemma and a 2^|M| table.
(3) The coverage law r = n - dim K as a testable description of v2 under extras, with a fixture at the one-odd-block boundary.
(4) sigma as a rule separating compression failure from a hard trace.
(5) A_vc, an explicit extras adversary against MDP, TRC and v2 together.
Unchanged: no residual-state bound and no universality claim.
